In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''conquered''' the [[Ten Tempests system]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Ten months after the beginning of the invasion,<ref name="BP" /> the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] managed to invade [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]],<ref name="TNJOS">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> despite an [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] flanking attack on Yuuzhan Vong positions.<ref name="BP" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was first mentioned in the [[2000]] novel [[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point|''Balance Point'']] as an ''Adumari [sic] flanking attack on Yuuzhan Vong positions up near [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]''.<ref name="BP" /> On the other hand, the [[2009]] guide ''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]'' stated that Vortex was invaded by the Yuuzhan Vong by the time of ''Balance Point''.<ref name="TNJOS" /> The [[2009]] guide ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' eventually combined those facts in its second map of the Yuuzhan Vong War, revealing that New Republic forces from Adumar attacked the Yuuzhan Vong at Vortex, located in the neighborhood of Bilbringi.<ref name="Atlas" />
